title: Digital Learning & Technology Intern
description: Company: Obelisk Training Location: Remote / Work from Home Employment Type: Internship with potential for long-term employment Experience: Fresh graduates and early-career professionals welcome About the Opportunity Are you someone who loves technology, learns new things quickly and enjoys figuring out how things work? Do you find yourself exploring new applications, experimenting with AI tools, building things online or teaching yourself skills simply because you're curious? If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. At Obelisk Training , we're looking for a curious, motivated and tech-savvy individual to join our team as a Digital Learning & Technology Intern . This isn't a traditional internship where you'll be limited to repetitive administrative tasks. You'll gain exposure to a broad range of digital technologies, learning platforms, eLearning development tools, website technologies, automation and AI-powered solutions. We're not expecting you to know everything when you join. In fact, we're more interested in how quickly you can learn, how independently you can solve problems and how willing you are to explore unfamiliar technologies . You'll receive guidance, practical training and opportunities to work on real projects. Our goal is to develop someone who can grow with us into a skilled digital learning technology professional. What You'll Be Working On You'll gradually gain hands-on experience across several areas, including: 1. Learning Platforms & Educational Technology Exploring, configuring and managing Learning Management Systems (LMS). Working with platforms such as LearnWorlds, Moodle and other digital learning solutions. Setting up online courses, learner journeys, assessments and digital learning environments. Testing platform functionality and improving the learner experience. 2. eLearning Development & Digital Design Creating engaging digital learning content and interactive learning experiences. Exploring eLearning authoring tools and multimedia development applications. Working with visual design tools to create course interfaces, graphics and digital resources. Understanding how learning experiences are designed, developed and delivered. 3. Automation, AI & Integrations Exploring workflow automation tools such as Zapier, Make and other integration platforms. Understanding how different applications communicate and exchange data. Learning about APIs, webhooks and automated workflows. Using AI tools to improve productivity, develop solutions and streamline processes. Supporting the testing and troubleshooting of automated workflows. 4. Websites & Digital Technologies Working with website builders, landing pages and online learning portals. Developing basic HTML, CSS and JavaScript skills where required. Supporting website customisation and user experience improvements. Investigating technical issues and identifying practical solutions. 5. Testing, Troubleshooting & Continuous Improvement Testing digital learning platforms, courses, websites and integrations. Identifying issues and working towards solutions. Researching new tools and technologies. Documenting processes and learning from project experiences. Contributing ideas to improve existing systems and workflows. Who We're Looking For We're looking for attitude and aptitude, not an impressive list of previous job titles. You'll be a great fit if you: Are genuinely passionate about technology and enjoy learning new things. Are a quick learner who can adapt to unfamiliar software and systems. Have strong logical thinking and problem-solving skills. Are comfortable using computers, web applications and digital tools. Enjoy researching, experimenting and figuring things out independently. Have an eye for design, detail and user experience. Are organised, dependable and capable of managing assigned tasks. Have good written and verbal communication skills. Are proactive, take ownership and are comfortable asking questions when needed. Can work independently and communicate effectively in a remote environment. Most importantly, you must have a genuine desire to learn, develop your skills and build a long-term career. Skills That Would Be an Advantage Any exposure to the following would be helpful, but is not essential: HTML, CSS, JavaScript or basic programming concepts. Website development or website builders. Canva, Figma or other design tools. Learning management systems or online course platforms. AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or other AI-powered applications. Automation tools such as Zapier, Make or n8n. Basic understanding of APIs, integrations or databases. Video editing, multimedia or digital content creation. You do not need to have experience in all these areas. We will provide training and opportunities to learn. What You'll Gain Practical, hands-on experience with real digital technology projects. Exposure to a variety of learning platforms, tools and systems. Guidance and mentoring as you develop your skills. Opportunities to explore emerging technologies, AI and automation. Experience working on projects from initial setup through to testing and delivery. A supportive environment that encourages curiosity, experimentation and continuous learning. Opportunities to take on increasing responsibility as your skills develop. A potential pathway to a permanent role and long-term career growth , subject to performance and business requirements. Career Progression This position is designed as an entry point into a broader career in digital learning and educational technology. Depending on your interests, strengths and performance, you may progress towards roles such as: Learning Technology Associate Digital Learning Developer LMS & Integration Specialist Learning Technology Specialist Learning Solutions Consultant How to Apply We'd love to know more about how you think and what motivates you , rather than simply reviewing your qualifications. Please submit your resume along with a short response to the following questions: What interests you most about working with digital technology? Tell us about something technical you have learnt independently. How did you learn it? Have you ever created, designed, automated or built something using a digital tool? Tell us about it. If you were asked to learn a completely unfamiliar software platform, how would you approach it? What is one technology or digital skill you're currently interested in learning, and why? You don't need to have all the answers. We want someone who is enthusiastic about finding them. If you're curious, adaptable, resourceful and excited about building a career in technology, we'd love to hear from you. Join Obelisk Training and grow your career in digital learning technology.
